research_question: Can candidate ion-channel transcript detection in annotated Drosophila clock-neuron groups and author-reported high-confidence rhythm calls be transferred into evidence schemas without implying electrophysiological or causal evidence?
hypothesis: A hash-bound handoff preserves target-group scope, LD/ZT versus DD/CT labels, traceability and uncertainty while leaving unsupported ranking dimensions unscored.
alternative_hypotheses: Raw UMI non-detection may reflect single-cell dropout rather than biological absence.
A rhythm call in mixed LN_ITP may not be attributable to pure s-LNv or LNd.
Omission from the author high-confidence table may reflect thresholds rather than true arrhythmicity.
Transcript detection or rhythmicity may not predict protein, current, membrane potential or behavior.
preparation: Published GSE157504 clock-neuron single-cell RNA-seq tables; no raw matrix reprocessing.
cell_type: Annotated clock-neuron groups; pure named groups are distinguished from mixed LN_ITP.
experimental_unit: cell nested within collection replicate; no fly-level inference
primary_readout: Candidate transcript-evidence rows and linked search records; unsupported ranking dimensions remain NA.
secondary_readouts: Readiness diagnostic, not a biological rank
time_system: LD is ZT; DD is CT; no phase is recomputed.
required_metadata: cell group, condition and time system
author rhythm class and reported statistics
analysis_plan: Build evidence rows using input SHA-256 values from the parent manifest; create two source-log rows per candidate; validate both schemas; score only as evidence readiness. The scorer identifies readout_domain and states that transcript directness is not channel function, and current/membrane-potential observations alone do not establish causality without candidate perturbation and controls. The bridge manifest is verified and all four runs are replayed in an isolated mirror.
decision_gate: Accept only if the 15-candidate table, 30 source-log rows, validators, manifest integrity, isolated output-hash replay and readout-scope semantics pass; all seven numeric ranking dimensions remain NA.
acceptance_tests: Manifest has 11 hash-verified files, four runs, no issues/warnings.
Isolated replay matches all seven declared output hashes.
Synthetic positive, missing feature, zero-count/dropout, mixed-cluster, input-hash mismatch and condition/time mismatch behave as specified.
Real inputs yield 15 candidate rows and 30 validated source-log rows.
All seven ranking dimensions remain NA and all candidates remain needs_evidence.

The scorer identifies the matched readout domain; molecular expression/localization directness is not channel function, and electrophysiological observations alone do not assert causality absent candidate perturbation and controls.
LD=ZT, DD=CT, LN_ITP ambiguity and dropout uncertainty remain explicit.

verification.focused_real_bridge_tests: 4 passed with ResourceWarning treated as error

inference_limitations: Cells are nested, not independent flies.
Raw UMI detection is descriptive; zero counts do not prove absence.
Author rhythm rows are transcribed, not refit.
No protein localization, current, membrane-potential rhythm, causal channel function or behavior is established.
